div.div:
خَصَّافٌ One who sews soles [so as to make them double, covering, or facing, one piece with another: see 1]: (Kr, K:) or one who patches soles; who mends them by sewing on other pieces. (Msb.) ―
-b2- (tropical:) One who covers his pudendum with his hand: on the authority of Seer. (TA. [See 1.]) ―
-b3- (tropical:) A liar: (Kr, K, TA:) as though he sewed one saying upon another, and [thus] embellished it. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
